integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action fantasy, cinematic, first-person POV. The frame opens exactly as in <Picture 1>: slender female hands cupped at bottom center holding a rough golden rutilated quartz raw stone, a jewel-forest clearing ringed by translucent crystal trees and diamond pillars glowing warm orange, pale purple, and light blue, a reflective gemstone path leading toward distant crystal spires under a tranquil dusk sky with a warm orange horizon glow. The hands gently lift and toss the raw stone upward; it arcs up center-frame, spinning, its rough mineral skin scattering fine golden glints while the internal golden needles catch the light like a released golden nebula, accompanied by a soft whoosh and crisp chime-like refraction tones. The stone reaches its apex and falls, rotating, its internal golden filaments lighting up one by one, then lands at the exact center of the clearing — a clear, long crystal "ding—" rises from the ground as golden light ripples outward from the impact point across the gem ground, with a low hum from the expanding light wave. The light erupts upward like sunlight surging from underground, and a castle of rutilated quartz rapidly condenses at the clearing center — blocky yet light, alternating rough mineral skin and smooth crystal faces, golden threads floating inside every wall. Once formed, a fence of rutilated quartz posts grows from the surrounding ground, each topped with a small glowing golden gem, and five or six entry steps extend toward the viewer. The POV holds, gazing at the warm golden castle glowing in the dusk, then walks forward — the gem ground gives crisp footstep echoes; stepping onto the stairs, a golden halo spreads underfoot, stair facets scatter fine light patterns, and the fence-top gems twinkle. The gaze lifts to the door; a hand reaches out and pushes, and the door opens silently into a two-story-high interior built entirely of rutilated quartz — walls, floor, and ceiling mixing rough and polished golden surfaces, golden threads suspended inside every block, warm golden motes drifting in the air like fine golden silk. The camera remains a continuous first-person POV throughout with no cuts.

overall_soundscape: A soft whoosh accompanies the tossed stone, followed by crisp chime-like refraction tones as it spins in the air. A resonant, long crystal "ding—" rings out on impact with a low hum from the expanding light wave, then crisp footstep echoes sound on the gem ground and stairs, ending in the silent swing of the opening door.
